name: LOVEMACHINE
source:
//Sequence one

It's your first date with that girl from your neighborhood.

You're nervous, but you'll try to play it cool.

This could be the start of a beautiful relationship.

[from [url=https://hiromu656.itch.io/lovemachine]itch.io[/url]]
